items.quote: The Differential Thermal Analysis (DTA) experiments were performed to measure the transition temperatures thanks to a thermo-balance Setaram Setsys 16/18; alumina crucibles were used.
A quantitative evaluation of the phase compositions at room temperature was performed using the Energy Dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX).

items.calibration: aluminium (660.3   C), silver (961.8   C), gold (1064   C) and copper (1085   C) as references
items.quote: The temperature measurements were provided by a thermocouple type B (made by two wires of composition 94%wt Pt, 6%wt Rh and 70%wt Pt, 30%wt Rh), calibrated using aluminium (660.3   C), silver (961.8   C), gold (1064   C) and copper (1085   C) as references; the maximum calibration error was estimated to be 2   C.
Samples were heated up to 1500   C at rates from 1 to 20   C/min.
After the DTA, samples were enrobed in a resin Epofix (Struers) and then polished before being observed at the Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM, Zeiss).
Ingots of silicon (purity at 99.95%wt) copper (99.95%wt) and iron (99.9%wt) were selected and weighted depending on the established compositions.
Due to the metallic nature of the investigated systems, the samples were prepared using the arc-melting technique.

items.label: CuFeSi-1
items.quote: Sample CuFeSi-1 is characterised by five reactions.

items.label: CuSi-3
items.quote: In particular, in sample CuSi-3 the dark dendrites (containing in average 98.54%at Si and 1.46%at Cu) are spread everywhere in the h'' white matrix (formed by 21.33%at Si and 78.67%at Cu), as shown in Fig. 4.

items.label: CuFeSi-6
items.quote: Looking at the phases at room temperature of CuFeSi-6 (Fig. 6B), Fe-bcc (characterised by the atomic composition 2.79% Cu, 69.53% Fe and 27.68% Si) is surrounded by a thin layer of FeSi (atomic composition: 2.52% Cu, 47.06% Fe and 50.42% Si) and included in a Cu-fcc matrix (atomic composition: 89.61% Cu, 4.53% Fe and 5.85% Si).

items.label: CuFeSi-2
items.quote: Considering CuFeSi-2, the Si-rich diamond (whose atomic composition determined by EDX is 0.26% Cu, 0.40% Fe and 99.34% Si) and the Cu-rich h'' phases (atomic composition: 75.40% Cu, 0.75% Fe and 23.85% Si) are surrounded by a matrix of FeSi2- L (atomic composition: 0.19% Cu, 30.41% Fe and 69.40% Si).
